The '''Lorelli Reach''' was a quadrant on the outer edge of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and was of a medium size. All in all, the quadrant contained a total amount of five inhabited [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], one [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lane]], and one [[Space station/Legends|space station]].
